title: Traefik Access Log HTTP Status Leaderboard
dataSources: Proxmox node/VM metrics (`proxmox:metric`), Docker container stats (`docker:stats`), Synology/TrueNAS (`synology:disk`, `truenas:pool`), Raspberry Pi host metrics, UPS status via NUT (`nut:ups`).
app: Proxmox / Docker / Portainer, Synology/TrueNAS, Raspberry Pi, and UPS (NUT) metrics via the Splunk Universal Forwarder, collectd/telegraf, and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=traefik:access status_code=*
| stats sum(status_code) as total_value, avg(status_code) as avg_value by service_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks service values by total and average http status across Traefik access log events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `status_code` values for each Traefik access log event and review total and average http status by service.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total http status.
grandmaExplanation: It regularly which service shows the biggest http status numbers in your Traefik access log data.
